1.name: Thokal Joy Bhagwan
1.verse: For I know the plans I have for you... plans to give you hope and a future.

2.name: Uthayaraj V
2.verse: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

3.name: Abhishek Prakash Yogi
3.verse: Be strong and courageous... the LORD your God will be with you wherever you go.

4.name: Jackson Samuel S
4.verse: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

5.name: Jackson Samuvel Durai Y
5.verse: Take delight in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

6.name: Praison Clement V
6.verse: Do not fear, for I am with you.

7.name: Ezra G
7.verse: In all things God works for the good of those who love him.

8.name: Herlan Ebenezar Paul H
8.verse: Seek first his kingdom and his righteousness.

9.name: Paul Benny Hinn S
9.verse: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

10.name: Hebron Sam Jebasingh W
10.verse: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart.

11.name: James Lisu
11.verse: God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love.

12.name: Rinu Roy
12.verse: Let us not become weary in doing good.

13.name: Sanderson Paul M
13.verse: God is our refuge and strength.

14.name: Johanson Jebaraj
14.verse: Apart from me you can do nothing.

15.name: Dara Prem Vikas

16.name: Glennpaul S
16.verse: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go.

17.name: Joel Jose

18.name: Munganda Joy Benhanan

19.verse: Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

21.name: Moses Premkumar J

22.name: Yeddu Deeven Kumar

26.name: Arun El Gershom Raja S
